provenance.sourcePublisher: Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) / Singapore Business Federation (SBF)
provenance.extractionMethod: Headless Chromium via agent-browser (Playwright-based). Rendered DOM queried with CSS selectors after full client-side hydration. document.body.innerText captured in full (63,928 characters). No accordions required expansion: all 30 winner panels are present in the hydrated DOM.
provenance.categoryDerivation: Two .winners lists exist in the DOM. Items 0-14 belong to list index 0 (Innovation Excellence, 15 winners). Items 15-29 belong to list index 1 (Adoption Excellence, 15 winners).
notes: The page publishes no individual winner URLs. Stable local permalinks are generated from company slugs.
Company logos are hosted by IMDA at services2.imda.gov.sg; they are not reproduced in this project.
